intro: This short video shows how new riders join RWB, how to find them, and what to do when someone leaves.
list: RWB has one master member list.
And our Google Sheet keeps a copy of it, automatically.
You never have to copy anything by hand.
notapp: Being a member is not the same as having the app.
Some members have installed the app, and some haven't.
That's okay. They are all members.
And if someone deletes the app, they are still a member.
way1: There are two ways to join.
Way one: the rider fills the join form on our website.
Within seconds, they are added to the member list, with a green New Member tag.
There is nothing for you to do.
way2: Way two: the rider installs the app first, and sends a join request.
You get a notification, and a banner on the Home screen.
Check their details, and tap Approve.
That's it. They are added to the member list and the Google Sheet.
approve: Done! They are now a member.
find: Next, adding new members to our WhatsApp group.
Open the RWB tab, and tap New.
You will see everyone who joined in the last seven days, from the form or the app.
The green tag goes away by itself after a week.
findapp: Here it is in the app.
Tap New to see the new members.
Tap a name, then tap WhatsApp.
Message them, or add their number to the group.
Do this once a week, and nobody gets missed.
edit: If a member's details change, fix them in the app.
The Google Sheet updates by itself.
But remember: changes typed into the sheet do not reach the app.
So always edit in the app, never in the sheet.
remove: Now, when someone leaves the group.
Open their profile, and tap Remove from RWB.
Choose: Left the group, or Removed by admin.
Add a short note, so other admins know why.
results: They disappear from the member list.
Their app login and their data are deleted.
Their row moves out of the Google Sheet, into a tab called Removed members.
And admins can still see them, under Left or removed.
removeapp: Search for the member, and open their profile.
Pick the reason, add a note, type REMOVE, and confirm.
donts: Deleting a row in the Google Sheet does not remove anyone.
And uninstalling the app does not remove anyone either.
Always use the Remove from RWB button.
back: Removed someone by mistake? No problem.
Tap Left or removed, tap their name, and tap Restore.
And if someone who left fills the join form again, they come back automatically, and you get a notification.
rules: To sum up, four simple habits.
One. Approve join requests every day.
Two. Check New every week, and add them to WhatsApp.
Three. Edit details only in the app.
Four. Remove members only with Remove from RWB.
outro: Thank you for looking after our warriors.
